rows.title: The germinal main import reason page: two reasons, four purposes, the Transit answers and their errors
rows.detail: The germinal products set has its own copy of the main import reason page. It keeps the live-animals page's heading, caption, legend, back link and journey buttons, but offers only Internal market and Transit, each with a hint worded for consignments. Internal market reveals the purpose question with four purposes, each with its germinal hint; Transit reveals the port of exit and destination country questions. The set offers no temporary admission, so the page asks no exit date. Missing answers are refused with the live-animals messages, and a valid answer goes on to Commodity details.
acceptanceCriteria: The germinal page has the h1 and browser title 'Main import reason', the caption 'About the consignment', the visually hidden legend 'What is the main reason for importing the animals?', a Back link to 'What are you importing?' and the buttons 'Save and continue', 'Save and return to overview' and 'Cancel and return to overview'; its status strip names the notification as germinal products. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-097; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-071, -p3-075, -p3-082, -p3-084; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p8-063)

The germinal page offers the reasons Internal market and Transit, in that order. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p3-018; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-047-m1; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-005)

On the germinal page Internal market has the hint 'For consignments intended for sale or use in Great Britain (England, Scotland or Wales).' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-090, -p4-091; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-073)

On the germinal page Transit has the hint 'For consignments moving through Great Britain for direct travel to a third country, that will enter Great Britain at one port or airport and leave from a different one within England, Scotland or Wales.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-090, -p4-092; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-074)

Choosing Internal market reveals 'Purpose in the internal market', offering Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift, Breeding, Research and Production, in that order. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p3-040; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-090; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-025)

On the germinal page Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift has the hint 'Any movement of a consignment that has as its aim the sale of or the transfer of ownership of the consignment from one person or entity to another. For example, animals that have been sold and are being moved to a new owner or will be sold once in Great Britain, purchases from a breeder/shop overseas and where an animal is being moved to a new owner with no sale involved (for example a gift).' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-093; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-077)

On the germinal page Breeding has the hint 'Consignments for reproduction. This includes animals and germinal products intended to contribute to the genetic pool of a breeding program, improve livestock quality, or produce offspring.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-094; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-078)

On the germinal page Research has the hint 'Animals and germinal products for use in scientific or medical research.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-095; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-079)

On the germinal page Production has the hint 'Animals and germinal products that are farmed for the production of meat, milk, eggs, wool or any other animal product or by-product.' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-096; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-080)

Choosing Transit on the germinal page reveals 'Port of exit' then 'Destination country', in that order, offering the same lists as the live-animals page. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p3-047, -p3-050; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-047-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-082)

The germinal page's further questions are the purpose under Internal market and the port of exit and destination country under Transit, and the live-animals main import reason page keeps its exit date question. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p3-056, -p3-058, -p3-064; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-005, -p1-006, -p1-007)

Saving Internal market with no purpose, or with a purpose other than the four the page offers, shows 'Select a purpose in the internal market' in the error summary and on the field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-065; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-081; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p3-023; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p8-100)

Saving Transit with neither answer shows 'Select a port of exit' then 'Select a destination country' in the error summary, and each message on its own field. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-065; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-082; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p8-102)

Saving Internal market with one of its four purposes, or Transit with a port of exit and a destination country, opens Commodity details. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p4-065; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-083)
rows.notes: One slice per germinal page requirement (req-2236 reveals, req-2602 and req-2603 reason hints, req-2604 to req-2607 purpose hints, req-2608 page frame, req-2609 errors and next page), combined because they are all the one germinal main import reason page. existingRow inc-024 already holds every one of them: the combiner keeps its id, theme, dependencies and other areas' criteria (the germinal start), and states each criterion once. The Transfer of ownership hint here is the full two-sentence hint req-2604 states, including the sentence that still speaks of animals, which the design renders as written; inc-024's current criterion quotes only the first sentence and should take this wording. The no-exit-date criterion states the complete set of questions the page asks rather than the absent one. Open questions on the live-animals page (the exit date format, the type-ahead and the reveal styling) are not built here: they are live-animals questions with defaults that keep what is built.

rows.title: A germinal products notification is certified for 'Germinal products' from the start, shown on the review and published
rows.detail: A germinal products consignment can only be certified for germinal products, so the germinal set never asks it. The draft is created already holding 'Germinal products', the review shows it in the Additional details card with no way to change it, and submitting publishes it as the certified-for declaration clause like any other answer.
acceptanceCriteria: A newly created germinal products notification's review page shows an 'Additional details' card holding one row, 'Certified for', reading 'Germinal products' as plain text with no Change link, before the trader has answered any journey page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019, -p1-020; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-115, -p1-115-m1)

Submitting a germinal products notification publishes the certified-for value 'Germinal products' in the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS declaration clause of its published event, seen in the admin's outbox events view. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-016, -p2-017; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-115, -p1-115-m1)

sources.ref: §Live Animal Data Elements, row "Animals certified for": confluence-6497338582-p1-115, -p1-115-m1

rows.notes: One slice (req-182), the review and publishing half of the germinal certified-for answer. existingRow inc-182 already holds it: the combiner keeps its id, theme, dependencies and the other areas' criteria (the journey-flow area's draft states the draft holding the value and no page asking it), and states each criterion once. No backend change is expected: the record stores certified-for as free text and the publishing mapper already sends it as the certified-for clause, so the germinal set's own start sets the value when it creates the draft, not the shared stub create lifecycle that the split-off manage-notifications theme owns.

splitOff.why: It sets the review's exit port label to 'Port of exit' for transit and temporary admission, which lives in the live-animals check answers copy (features/check-answers/copy), code the overview-and-review theme owns. Main already shows 'Port of exit' there, so the branch only needs to confirm it.
